notes.title: Mini Boss Update
notes.content:
Finished a update for this here game. For this update i was making things look nicer and then after some discussion with beta players i started to add mini bosses. Each level now has a unique mini boss that drops a pickup. 3 of the set mini boss for that level appear so watch out

Changes

Enemies drop health and ammo
Projectiles have particle trails
9 Mini bosses
